interview_rounds: Online Assessment → Phone Screen → 4-5 Onsite Rounds (Coding + System Design + Behavioral)
focus_areas: DSA (medium-hard), system design, Googleyness & Leadership
tips: Focus on LeetCode medium/hard problems. Practice writing clean code on a whiteboard. Emphasize collaborative problem-solving. Google values thought process over correct answers.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment → 4-5 Rounds (Coding + Design + Behavioral with as appropriate)
focus_areas: DSA, object-oriented design, system design for senior roles
tips: Strong focus on data structures fundamentals. Practice explaining your approach before coding. Microsoft values clear communication and structured thinking. Expect OS and networking questions.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment → Phone Screen → 4 Onsite Loops (Coding + System Design + Leadership Principles)
focus_areas: Leadership Principles (critical), DSA, system design, scalability
tips: Prepare STAR format stories for each of Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles. They're not optional — every round includes LP questions. Practice system design for distributed systems.

interview_rounds: Phone Screen → 3-4 Onsite Rounds (Coding + System Design + Behavioral)
focus_areas: Coding speed and accuracy, system design at scale, behavioral (Meta values)
tips: Meta emphasizes coding speed — practice completing problems in 20 minutes. System design questions focus on social media scale (billions of users). Be ready to discuss impact of your past work.

interview_rounds: Phone Screen → 5-6 Onsite Rounds with different teams
focus_areas: Domain-specific knowledge, coding, design thinking, attention to detail
tips: Apple interviews are team-specific — research your target team beforehand. They value depth over breadth. Expect questions about user experience and product thinking alongside technical questions.

interview_rounds: Online Coding Round → Machine Coding Round → 2-3 Technical Interviews → HR
focus_areas: DSA, machine coding (build a mini-project in 90 mins), system design
tips: The machine coding round is unique to Flipkart — practice building small applications (parking lot, snake game) with clean OOP in 90 minutes. Strong focus on code quality and design patterns.

interview_rounds: Online Test (Aptitude + Coding) → 2-3 Technical Rounds → HR
focus_areas: DSA, aptitude, OOPS concepts, puzzles, database concepts
tips: Goldman has a unique aptitude section with mathematical puzzles. Brush up on probability, permutations, and logical reasoning. They test Java/OOP concepts heavily. Know your database normalization.

interview_rounds: Online Test (Aptitude + Coding) → Technical Interview → HR Interview
focus_areas: Aptitude, basic coding, DBMS, OS fundamentals, communication
tips: Infosys InfyTQ platform offers early advantage for strong candidates. Focus on aptitude preparation and basic programming concepts. Communication skills matter — practice explaining technical concepts clearly.

interview_rounds: TCS NQT (National Qualifier Test) → Technical Interview → MR/HR Interview
focus_areas: Aptitude (verbal, quant, reasoning), basic programming, communication
tips: TCS NQT score is crucial. Prepare for aptitude, verbal ability, and programming MCQs. The Digital role (higher CTC) requires stronger coding skills. Practice on TCS iON platform for familiarity.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment (Aptitude + Coding) → Technical Round → HR
focus_areas: Aptitude, basic programming (C/Java/Python), essay writing
tips: Wipro's Elite NLTH program offers higher packages. Essay writing is part of the assessment — practice writing on technology topics. Focus on core CS concepts rather than advanced DSA.

interview_rounds: GenC Online Test → Technical Interview → HR Interview
focus_areas: Aptitude, coding, SQL, basic CS fundamentals
tips: Cognizant GenC Elevate and GenC Pro offer higher packages with tougher assessments. Practice SQL queries and basic programming. Strong communication skills can set you apart.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment → Group Discussion → Technical Interview → HR
focus_areas: Aptitude, communication, basic tech, business awareness
tips: Deloitte has a unique group discussion round. Practice articulating opinions confidently. They value consulting mindset — demonstrate structured problem-solving and business awareness.

interview_rounds: Cognitive + Technical Assessment → Coding Round → Communication Test → Interview
focus_areas: Aptitude, coding basics, communication, adaptability
tips: Accenture's communication assessment includes email writing and video response. Practice professional email writing. The coding round tests basic problem-solving — no advanced DSA needed.

interview_rounds: Online Coding → 2-3 Technical Rounds (Coding + System Design) → Culture Fit
focus_areas: Strong DSA, system design for payments, databases, distributed systems
tips: Razorpay focuses heavily on backend skills and system design for payment systems. Understand concepts like idempotency, event-driven architecture, and data consistency. Good knowledge of databases is essential.

interview_rounds: Online Coding → Machine Coding → 2-3 Technical Interviews → Hiring Manager
focus_areas: DSA, machine coding, system design, product thinking
tips: Zomato values product-minded developers. In system design, think about restaurant search, delivery routing, and real-time order tracking. Machine coding round: build a clean mini-project in 90 minutes.

interview_rounds: Online Coding → Machine Coding → 2-3 Technical → Bar Raiser
focus_areas: Java/Kotlin, system design for fintech, DSA, low-level design
tips: PhonePe is Java-heavy. Practice low-level design (LLD) problems: design a parking lot, elevator, or payment system. They have a 'bar raiser' round focused on depth of knowledge.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment → Values Interview → Technical (Coding + Design) → Hiring Manager
focus_areas: Values-based interviewing, coding, system design, collaboration
tips: Atlassian's values interview is critical — prepare specific stories around their 5 values (Open Company, Build with Heart, etc.). Technical rounds focus on practical problem-solving over trick questions.

interview_rounds: Phone Screen → 4-5 Onsite (Coding + System Design + Behavioral)
focus_areas: DSA, system design (ride-sharing scale), strong coding skills
tips: System design questions often relate to Uber's domain: ride matching, surge pricing, ETA calculation. Practice designing real-time location-based systems. Focus on trade-offs in your answers.

interview_rounds: Online Assessment → Technical Interview → HR Interview
focus_areas: Coding basics, cloud computing, AI/ML awareness, communication
tips: IBM values cloud and AI awareness. Familiarize yourself with IBM Cloud and Watson. The technical interview covers fundamentals — not heavy DSA. Show passion for emerging technologies.

interview_rounds: Game-based Assessment → Coding MCQ → Technical Interview → HR
focus_areas: Aptitude, game-based reasoning, basic coding, communication
tips: Capgemini uses a unique game-based psychometric assessment. Practice logical reasoning games. The coding section is MCQ-based, not full implementations. Strong English communication is valued.
